title: A Plane Lunar Eclipse
explanation: Did you need to be on the right side of this airplane to see this eclipse? No.  Lunar eclipses are routinely seen from the half of the Earth facing the Moon when the eclipse occurs, making them some of the most commonly witnessed astronomical events. You don't even need any special equipment to see one -- just your unaided eyes.
